sources.title: Indiana Election Division, 2022 General Election certified results archive (US Representative, office category 1005, JSON data file)
Indiana Election Division, 2022 General Election Results (archive site; settings.json Certified = T)

method: pipeline/patches/2022_IN_HOUSE.py reads the certified district-by-county results for the 9 regular districts (the same-day 2nd District special election, office 2936, is excluded) and sums every district touching a county; party D -> dem, R -> rep, all others including write-ins -> oth.
validation: CSV statewide dem 716,348 / rep 1,108,351 / oth 31,850 vs sum of the 9 certified regular district totals dem 716,348 / rep 1,108,351 / oth 31,850: difference 0 / 0 (0.00%). Of the 38 counties in MIT, 34 match exactly; 3 are zero in MIT and Kosciusko (18085, split CD2/CD3) differs slightly (MIT 4,058 D / 17,981 R vs official 3,994 / 17,757).
